sections.content: Grover finds a marked item in an unstructured database of size N in about sqrt(N) steps — a quadratic speedup. Oracle flips the marked phase; diffusion amplifies the amplitude.

import os, sys
_LQE = os.environ.get("LQE_PATH", os.path.abspath(os.path.join("..", "legitimate_quantum_engine_v5.0")))
_ECO = os.environ.get("LQE_ECOSYSTEM_PATH", os.path.abspath(".."))
for _p in (_LQE, _ECO):
    if _p not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(0, _p)
from legitimate_quantum_engine.core.statevector import StatevectorSim
import numpy as np
sim = StatevectorSim(2)
sim.apply('H', 0); sim.apply('H', 1)
st = sim.state.copy(); st[3] *= -1; sim.state = st
sim.apply('H', 0); sim.apply('H', 1)
st = sim.state.copy(); mean = np.mean(st); sim.state = 2*mean - st
sim.apply('H', 0); sim.apply('H', 1)
print('Probs after 1 Grover iter:', np.round(sim.probabilities(), 4))
